doc.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Sandke and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I appreciate your eloquent thoughts on that subject. And I hope that in a few years we can do this again and we’ll be able to talk about your recordings that focus on your concept.
Well maybe the orchestra record will be out by then so—
And whatever you’re calling it at the time, that’s cool. So on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank you.
Well it’s been a rare pleasure for me, because I don’t get a chance to spout off that much. So thanks a lot, Monk.
